queries.query: List all major Oil, Gas & Hydrogen projects in Ontario that have been announced, approved, begun construction, reached a milestone, been delayed, cancelled, or completed in the past four weeks or are currently under development in 2025-2026. Include both new builds (greenfield) and redevelopments, renovations, expansions, conversions, modernizations, and adaptive reuse projects (brownfield). Specifically include: oil sands projects, natural gas processing plants, LNG facilities and expansions, pipelines (new and expansions), refineries (new and modernizations), hydrogen production facilities, carbon capture and storage (CCS/CCUS) projects, upgraders, tank farms, offshore drilling platforms, gas plants, bitumen processing, petrochemical facilities, wellsite reclamation, and remediation projects. For each project provide: project name, proponent/developer, location, estimated value in dollars, current status (proposed, approved, under construction, completed, delayed, cancelled), and the source of the information.

List all major Mining & Critical Minerals projects in Ontario that have been announced, approved, begun construction, reached a milestone, been delayed, cancelled, or completed in the past four weeks or are currently under development in 2025-2026. Include both new builds (greenfield) and redevelopments, renovations, expansions, conversions, modernizations, and adaptive reuse projects (brownfield). Specifically include: new mines, mine expansions, mine life extensions, smelters, mineral processing plants, critical minerals projects (lithium, nickel, cobalt, graphite, rare earths, uranium, copper), potash mines, gold mines, iron ore projects, diamond mines, mine restarts and reopenings, tailings management facilities, mine remediation and reclamation, and mineral refining facilities. For each project provide: project name, proponent/developer, location, estimated value in dollars, current status (proposed, approved, under construction, completed, delayed, cancelled), and the source of the information.

List all major Civil Infrastructure projects in Ontario that have been announced, approved, begun construction, reached a milestone, been delayed, cancelled, or completed in the past four weeks or are currently under development in 2025-2026.
